classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that rolling changes which sheet dimension becomes circumference, recover both radii and justify the volume comparison.

content.prompt: Which cylinder would have a greater volume? Justify your answer with mathematical reasoning.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 15, branching A4 rolling illustration at lower left
spec.description: Landscape A4 sheet, 297 mm across and 210 mm high. A right arrow leads to an upright rolled cylinder captioned Curl up the long side; a downward arrow leads to a horizontal rolled cylinder captioned Curl up the short side.
spec.mathematics: Sheet side ratio 297:210. Long-side rolling gives circumference 297 mm and height 210 mm; short-side rolling gives circumference 210 mm and height 297 mm. Narrow longitudinal openings illustrate the rolling operation and do not specify a measured gap. Upright rolled surface uses cylindrical angular domain -80 to 260 degrees, omitting the front sector from 260 to 280 degrees. Horizontal surface is viewed from the positive axial direction; its front slit uses the same angular omission. Both are open rolled surfaces, not closed solids with filled end disks.
spec.answerVisibility: Sheet dimensions and source outcome captions only. Circumferences, radii, volumes and comparison are answer content.

answer.short: The cylinder labelled “Curl up the long side” has the greater volume.
answer.worked:
Curl up the short side:
$$\begin{align*}C&=2\pi r\\210&=2\pi r\\r&=\frac{210}{2\pi}\,\mathrm{mm}\\V_{\text{curl short side}}&=\pi r^2h\\V_{\text{curl short side}}&=\pi\left(\frac{210}{2\pi}\right)^2(297)\\V_{\text{curl short side}}&=\frac{13\,097\,700}{4\pi}\,\mathrm{mm}^3\end{align*}$$
Curl up the long side:
$$\begin{align*}C&=2\pi r\\297&=2\pi r\\r&=\frac{297}{2\pi}\,\mathrm{mm}\\V_{\text{curl long side}}&=\pi r^2h\\V_{\text{curl long side}}&=\pi\left(\frac{297}{2\pi}\right)^2(210)\\V_{\text{curl long side}}&=\frac{18\,523\,890}{4\pi}\,\mathrm{mm}^3\end{align*}$$
Since $18\,523\,890>13\,097\,700$, $\therefore$ the cylinder curled up the long side has the larger volume.
